scope: Unchanged executable S and recovered current Linux performance; hosted CI and reviewer access are separate external gates.
recovery_correction: No application, policy, dependency, host configuration or threshold change. Stable current-host recovery confirmed by predeclared alternating diagnostics followed by one complete acceptance batch.
historical_slowdown_root_cause: UNPROVEN. Historical 5.499146241s wall / 5.495827s CPU was CPU-bound; 0.013388355s persistence cannot explain it. Current source/runtime hashes match and the slowdown is no longer reproducible. Earlier 1700MHz versus current native frequency samples is consistent with host-performance variation but is not causal proof. Historical frequency, tracing and cgroup state were not sampled continuously, so the underlying historical cause cannot be established retrospectively.

controlled_comparison.method: Six predeclared alternating Phase 6/Phase 7 production-image launches, identical current host, Python, flags, environment, package inventory, application modules, input bytes, paths, timer, pipe capture and RSS observer.
controlled_comparison.image_difference: Wheel METADATA (README) and its RECORD digest differ; the ten application modules and common Python base layers are identical.
controlled_comparison.historical_reproduction_limit: Historical Phase 6 acceptance used /review/.venv/bin/python in the retained tools image with 51 development packages. The disposable historical container no longer exists. Current A/B uses both retained production images, each with the sole project distribution; it is a controlled current comparison, not an exact historical environment replay.

linux_environment.flags: sys.flags(debug=0, inspect=0, interactive=0, optimize=0, dont_write_bytecode=1, no_user_site=0, no_site=0, ignore_environment=0, verbose=0, bytes_warning=0, quiet=0, hash_randomization=1, isolated=0, dev_mode=False, utf8_mode=0, warn_default_encoding=0, safe_path=False, int_max_str_digits=4300)
linux_environment.input_location: ordinary /tmp/review container overlay filesystem, copied from byte-verified inputs before timing

correctness.note: Preserved successful S-bound results; no application/test/configuration change invalidates them.

measurement_limits: First-recorded launch per input/format is separate; files were already read, so no cold-cache claim.

Native subprocess creation through complete stdout/stderr capture is timed using the unchanged public linux_measure observer; snapshotting, hashing and evidence persistence follow or precede this boundary.
CPU is child user+system resource usage; RSS is sampled live VmHWM and may miss late peaks. Parent capture buffers are excluded.
WSL2/Docker Desktop shares the laptop with 19 existing containers. No workload, power, affinity, security, quota, cache or process-priority manipulation occurred.
Current recovery does not prove the historical root cause or guarantee hardware-independent performance.
hosted_ci: Pending actual execution after authorized publication; not certified by this local evidence.
reviewer_access: Invitations/access are externally verified after hosted CI; not certified by this local evidence.
